base.purpose: Inherited host font at keyword size small; buttons, menu items, the cut sentence and the problem view.

title.purpose: Toolbar title, the zoom value and chord names, weight 600.

label.purpose: Bar numbers, section names, marks, track names and the badge, 0.92em with tabular numerals.

numeral-label.purpose: Octave labels in the pitch column and the Chords label, 0.85em.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: The zoom menu in the top layer. The only shadow.

components.name: Zoom Value Button
components.description: Toolbar button that shows the zoom and opens the zoom menu.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 28%, #ffffff); border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; font: inherit; font-size: small; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button b { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-chev { width: 5px; height: 5px; margin-top: -3px; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 6%, #ffffff); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457d6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Read-only Badge
components.description: Pill at the end of the toolbar when the editor is not editable.
components.css: .ds-badge { padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 28%, #ffffff); border-radius: 999px; color: color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 66%, #ffffff); font-size: 0.92em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Note
components.description: One note: a block one row high, drawn from its start to its end less a 1px gap.
components.css: .ds-note { box-sizing: border-box; height: 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 30%, #2457d6); border-radius: 3px; background: #2457d6; }

components.name: Tied Notes
components.description: Two notes joined by a tie read as one connected bar: no gap, border or rounding where they meet.
components.css: .ds-tie { display: flex; } .ds-tie-a, .ds-tie-b { box-sizing: border-box; height: 14px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 30%, #2457d6); background: #2457d6; } .ds-tie-a { border-right-width: 0; border-radius: 3px 0 0 3px; } .ds-tie-b { border-left-width: 0; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; }

components.name: Cut Strip
components.description: The one sentence above the view when the score text stops before the song does, led by a swatch of the hatch.
components.html: This score is cut off: bar 232 of Ins is incomplete.
components.css: .ds-cut { padding: 6px 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 5%, #ffffff); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 13%, #ffffff); color: #18181b; font-size: small; } .ds-swatch { display: inline-block; width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; margin-right: 0.6em; border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 28%, #ffffff); background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 28%, #ffffff) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px); vertical-align: -0.2em; }

components.name: Menu Item
components.description: Radio item in the zoom menu; the dot marks the checked one.
components.css: .ds-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 190px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 10px 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-size: small; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dot { flex: none; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2457d6; } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #18181b 8%, transparent); } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2457d6; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The editor has no brand. It takes the look of its host through the public theme variables and ships only neutral defaults. It is an Operate surface, a read-only arrangement view that follows DAW conventions, with touch and keyboard first-class. The cut, a hatched tail for the part of a song the text never reached, is its one authored move.
keyCharacteristics: No identity of its own: colours and type come from the host; defaults are neutral.
Hairline structure: 1px lines, tonal fills, almost no shadow.
Two densities selected by pointer type, not by screen width.
Meaning never rests on colour alone: a cut is hatched and dashed, a tie is one joined bar, a missing chord track says so in words.
Text that does not fit its cell is left out whole, never cut mid-word.
Isolated styles: a host's element and class selectors do not reach in; inside a shadow root nothing does.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: The package never names a colour outside the variable contract and its neutral defaults.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent marks focus and the checked menu dot; the note colour defaults to the same value. Nothing else is tinted but the wash and the line of a lyric phrase, which take the two state hues.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change uses lining, tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Keyword Size Rule
rules.body: No px or rem font sizes. The root is a keyword; descendants are em. The one exception is the lyric track's text fields on a coarse pointer, 16px, so a phone does not zoom on focus.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing has a shadow at rest. A shadow marks a floating layer.

dos: Do take every colour from the theme variable contract or a color-mix of bg and text.
Do keep the neutral defaults described as defaults, and keep hosts' mapping optional.
Do size type with small at the root and em below, size header rows and pinned heads in em, and use tabular lining numerals for any number.
Do give every new interactive element a 2px accent outline with 2px offset on :focus-visible, and a coarse-pointer size.
Do say a state with a shape or words as well as colour.
Do leave out text that does not fit its cell, whole, instead of cutting it.
Do place anything on the time axis in percent of its axis element, and change the zoom only by setting those elements' widths.
Do put any new floating layer in a native popover so it reaches the top layer.
Do prefix every class with sce-, inject styles once per container, and release them on destroy.
donts: Don't state a brand: no fixed brand colour, no bundled font, no logo.
Don't hard-code px or rem font sizes, or a font family other than through --sce-font-family.
Don't hold the zoom, or anything else that changes while the user zooms or scrolls, in an inherited custom property on the root.
Don't rely on a host's cascade: keep the all: initial root, the all: revert descendants under the doubled class, and the hand-reset exception for notes.
Don't publish or depend on --sce-_* variables outside the stylesheet.
Don't import styles as a CSS file or leave nodes behind.
